# Missing email verification in middleware (2026-01-31 17:36Z)

_**User**_

Missing email identity verification step in middleware flow.

The middleware checks for publicUser and profile linkage but doesn't verify email identity first. Users who have authenticated via Google but haven't verified their work email would be redirected to /auth/pending-approval instead of /auth/verify-email.

This creates an inconsistent user experience where users see "Pending Approval" when they actually need to complete email verification first.

---

_**Agent (model composer-1, mode Agent)**_


Reviewing the middleware and email verification flow to ensure email verification is checked before profile linkage.

        "contents": "   - No Row Level Security policies\n   - No database triggers or functions\n   - All access control handled by Next.js\n\n### Next.js (Application Layer - All Business Logic)\n\n1. **Middleware Verification**:\n\n   - Queries &#96;profiles&#96;         "contents": "import { EnvVarWarning } from \"@/components/env-var-warning\";\nimport { AuthButton } from \"@/components/auth-button\";\nimport { ThemeSwitcher } from \"@/components/theme-switcher\";\nimport Link from \"next/link\";\nimport { Suspense } from \"react\";\nimport { createClient } from \"@/lib/supabase/server\";\nimport { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport { hasEmailIdentity } from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\n\nexport default async function ProtectedLayout({\n  children,\n}: {\n  children: React.ReactNode;\n}) {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\n\n  // Redirect to login if not authenticated\n  if (!data?.claims) {\n    redirect(\"/auth/login\");\n  }\n\n  // Redirect to verify email if no email identity linked\n  const hasEmail = await hasEmailIdentity();\n  if (!hasEmail) {\n    redirect(\"/auth/verify-email\");\n  }\n\n  return (\n    &lt;main className=\"min-h-screen flex flex-col items-center\"&gt;\n}",

        "contents": "import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from \"next/server\";\n\nexport async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {\n  let supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n    request,\n  });\n\n  // If the env vars are not set, skip proxy check. You can remove this\n  // once you setup the project.\n\n  // With Fluid compute, don't put this client in a global environment\n  // variable. Always create a new one on each request.\n  const supabase = createServerClient(\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY!,\n    {\n      cookies: {\n        getAll() {\n          return request.cookies.getAll();\n        },\n        setAll(cookiesToSet) {\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value }) =&gt;\n            request.cookies.set(name, value),\n          );\n          supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n            request,\n          });\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =&gt;\n            supabaseResponse.cookies.set(name, value, options),\n          );\n        },\n      },\n    },\n  );\n\n  // Do not run code between createServerClient and\n  // supabase.auth.getClaims(). A simple mistake could make it very hard to debug\n  // issues with users being randomly logged out.\n\n  // IMPORTANT: If you remove getClaims() and you use server-side rendering\n  // with the Supabase client, your users may be randomly logged out.\n  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\n  const user = data?.claims;\n\n  const pathname = request.nextUrl.pathname;\n  const isPublicRoute = pathname === \"/\" || pathname.startsWith(\"/auth\");\n\n  // Redirect to login if not authenticated (except for public routes)\n  if (!isPublicRoute &amp;&amp; !user) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/login\";\n    return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n  }\n\n  // Check for linked profile if user is authenticated and not on public routes\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * Checks if the authenticated user has a linked profile\n * @returns true if user has a linked profile, false otherwise\n */\nexport async function hasLinkedProfile(): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  const { data: { user }, error } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n  if (error || !user) {\n    return false;\n  }\n\n  // Get the public.users row linked to this auth user\n  const { data: publicUser } = await supabase\n    .from(\"users\")\n    .select(\"id\")\n    .eq(\"auth_user_id\", user.id)\n    .single();\n\n  if (!publicUser) {\n    return false;\n  }\n\n  // Check if there's a profile linked to this user\n  const { data: profile } = await supabase\n    .from(\"profiles\")\n    .select(\"id\")\n    .eq(\"user_id\", publicUser.id)\n    .single();\n\n  return !!profile;\n}",

        "contents": "await supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .update({ \n    user_id: user.id,\n    picture: user.user_metadata.avatar_url  // Default to Google picture\n  })\n  .eq('work_email', workEmail);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 4: Middleware Validation\n\nQuery database for profile linked to current auth.user and check &#96;removed_access IS NULL&#96; on every request to protected routes.\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Middleware check\nconst { data: profile } = await supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .select('id, role, removed_access')\n  .eq('user_id', user.id)\n  .single();\n\nif (!profile) redirect('/auth/verify-work-email');\nif (profile.removed_access) redirect('/auth/access-revoked');\n// User has active access, continue...\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Estimated Complexity\n\n| Task | Complexity | Lines of Code |\n\n|------|------------|---------------|\n\n| Delete old auth files | Trivial | -500 lines |\n\n| Security lockdown config | Trivial | ~20 lines TOML |\n\n| Database migration | Low | ~40 lines SQL (users, profiles, indexes) |\n\n| Constants + validation | Trivial | ~25 lines |\n\n| Server actions (auth logic) | Medium | ~60 lines |\n\n| Middleware update | Medium | ~50 lines (includes DB queries) |\n\n| Google login page | Low | ~30 lines |\n\n| Work email form + linking | Medium | ~120 lines |\n\n| Pending approval page | Low | ~20 lines |\n\n| Access revoked page | Low | ~20 lines |\n\n**Total new code**: ~385 lines (vs ~500 lines deleted)\n\n## Separation of Concerns\n\n### Supabase (Auth + Storage Only)\n\n- **Authentication**: Google OAuth flow, session management, OTP emails\n- **Database**: Store profiles and users data (no RLS - Next.js handles access control)\n- **No business logic**: No custom hooks, no stored procedures, no triggers, no functions\n\n### Next.js (All Business Logic)\n\n- **Middleware**: Profile verification, access checks, role-based routing\n- **Server Actions**: Profile linking, access revocation\n- **Validation**: Domain validation, input sanitization, business rules\n- **Authorization**: Role hierarchy checks, permission enforcement\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│                         Next.js                                  │",

        "contents": "import { createClient } from \"@/lib/supabase/server\";\nimport { InfoIcon } from \"lucide-react\";\nimport { FetchDataSteps } from \"@/components/tutorial/fetch-data-steps\";\nimport { Suspense } from \"react\";\n\nasync function UserDetails() {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\n\n  if (error || !data?.claims) {\n    redirect(\"/auth/login\");\n  }\n\n  return JSON.stringify(data.claims, null, 2);\n}\n\nexport default function ProtectedPage() {\n  return\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./supabase/migrations/20260131161556_link_users_to_profiles.sql",
        "range": {

        "contents": "-- Migration: Link users to profiles based on email matching\n-- Purpose: Automatically links profile rows to user rows when auth.users.email matches profiles.work_email\n-- Affected tables: profiles, users, auth.users\n-- Special considerations: Runs automatically when user email changes in auth.users table\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- FUNCTIONS\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Create trigger function to link profiles to users based on email matching\n-- Matches auth.users.email with profiles.work_email and links via public.users\n-- Runs with SECURITY DEFINER to access auth.users table\ncreate or replace function public.link_user_to_profile()\nreturns trigger\nlanguage plpgsql\nsecurity definer\nset search_path = public, auth\nas $$\ndeclare\n  v_user_id uuid;\n  v_auth_email text;\nbegin\n  -- Get the email from auth.users (use NEW.email after update)\n  v_auth_email := new.email;\n  \n  -- Only proceed if email is not null and has changed\n  if v_auth_email is null or v_auth_email = '' then\n    return new;\n  end if;\n  \n  -- Find the public.users row that matches this auth.users.id\n  select id into v_user_id\n  from public.users\n  where auth_user_id = new.id;\n  \n  -- If no matching public.users row found, return early\n  if v_user_id is null then\n    return new;\n  end if;\n  \n  -- Link profile to user if work_email matches auth.users.email\n  -- Only update if profile exists and is not already linked to a different user\n  update public.profiles\n  set user_id = v_user_id\n  where work_email = lower(trim(v_auth_email))\n    and (user_id is null or user_id = v_user_id);\n  \n  return new;\nend;\n$$;\n\ncomment on function public.link_user_to_profile() is 'Trigger function that automatically links profile rows to user rows when auth.users.email matches profiles.work_email. Matches based on currently logged in user email (auth.users.email), uid in user table row (public.users.auth_user_id), and work_email in profile table row (public.profiles.work_email).';\n\n-- ============================================================================",

        "contents": "import { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport { VerifyEmailForm } from \"@/components/verify-email-form\";\nimport { hasEmailIdentity } from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\n\n/**\n * Email verification page\n * Users must link an email via OTP to their Google OAuth account\n */\nexport default async function VerifyEmailPage() {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\n\n  // Redirect to login if not authenticated\n  if (!data?.claims) {\n    redirect(\"/auth/login\");\n  }\n\n  // Redirect to protected if already has email identity\n  const hasEmail = await hasEmailIdentity();\n  if (hasEmail) {\n    redirect(\"/protected\");\n  }\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"flex min-h-svh w-full items-center justify-center p-6 md:p-10\"&gt;\n      &lt;div className=\"w-full max-w-sm\"&gt;\n        &lt;VerifyEmailForm /&gt;\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n    &lt;/div&gt;\n  );\n}",

        "contents": "import { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport { type NextRequest } from \"next/server\";\n\nimport { hasEmailIdentity } from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\nimport { validateRedirectUrl } from \"@/lib/utils\";\n\n/**\n * Handles OAuth callback from Google\n * Exchanges the code for a session and redirects appropriately\n */\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n  const { searchParams, origin } = new URL(request.url);\n  const code = searchParams.get(\"code\");\n  const next = searchParams.get(\"next\");\n\n  if (code) {\n    const supabase = await createClient();\n    const { error } = await supabase.auth.exchangeCodeForSession(code);\n\n    if (!error) {\n      // Check if user has email identity linked\n      // If not, redirect to verify-email page\n      const hasEmail = await hasEmailIdentity();\n\n      // Validate the next parameter to prevent open redirects\n      const validatedNext = validateRedirectUrl(next, origin);\n      const redirectTo = validatedNext || (hasEmail ? \"/protected\" : \"/auth/verify-email\");\n\n      redirect(redirectTo);\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Redirect to error page if something went wrong\n  redirect(&#96;/auth/error?error=Failed to authenticate with Google&#96;);\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./.cursor/plans/work_email_auth_system_467a2b18.plan.md",

        "contents": "## Supabase Configuration Changes\n\nUpdate [&#96;supabase/config.toml&#96;](supabase/config.toml):\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n[auth]\nenable_manual_linking = true        # Required for work email linking\nenable_anonymous_sign_ins = false   # Block anonymous access\n\n[auth.email]\nenable_signup = false               # Block direct email/password signup\nenable_confirmations = false        # We use OTP for work email, not signup confirmation\n\n[auth.external.google]\nenabled = true\nclient_id = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID)\"\nsecret = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET)\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Profile Verification (Next.js Middleware)\n\nAll verification logic lives in Next.js middleware, not in Supabase:\n\n- **Profile Linked**: Check &#96;profiles.user_id&#96; matches current auth.user.id\n- **Access Active**: Check &#96;profiles.removed_access IS NULL&#96;\n- **User Role**: Read &#96;profiles.role&#96; column (student, team_leader, coach, admin)\n\nThis approach:\n\n- Keeps all business logic in Next.js (single source of truth)\n- Allows real-time updates (e.g., instant access revocation)\n- Admin pre-creates profiles, users link via work email verification\n- Supabase only handles auth + data storage (no custom hooks or functions)\n\n## Development &amp; Testing with Supabase MCP\n\nThe project has a &#96;supabase/&#96; directory with Supabase MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration available for:\n\n1. **Running migrations**: Apply and test database schema changes locally\n2. **Debugging auth flow**: Inspect user sessions and profile data\n3. **Testing verification logic**: Query profiles table for auth checks\n\n**Useful MCP commands for development:**\n\n- Seed test data into profiles table for auth testing\n- Inspect auth.users and profiles tables\n- Test profile linking and access revocation queries\n\n## Key Security Features\n\n### Supabase (Data Layer Only)\n\n1. **Database Constraints**:\n\n   - Domain constraint ensures only valid CZU domains in profiles\n   - Unique constraints on work_email, user_id\n\n2. **No RLS or Functions**:\n\n   - No Row Level Security policies\n   - No database triggers or functions",

        "contents": "comment on function public.link_user_to_profile() is 'Trigger function that automatically links profile rows to user rows when auth.users.email matches profiles.work_email. Matches based on currently logged in user email (auth.users.email), uid in user table row (public.users.auth_user_id), and work_email in profile table row (public.profiles.work_email).';\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- TRIGGERS\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Create trigger on auth.users table to link profiles when email changes\n-- Runs AFTER UPDATE to ensure email change is committed\ndrop trigger if exists link_user_to_profile_trigger on auth.users;\n\ncreate trigger link_user_to_profile_trigger\nafter update of email on auth.users\nfor each row\nwhen (old.email is distinct from new.email)\nexecute function public.link_user_to_profile();\n\ncomment on trigger link_user_to_profile_trigger on auth.users is 'Trigger that automatically links profiles to users when auth.users.email changes. Runs after email update to ensure the change is committed before linking.';\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- INITIAL DATA LINKING\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Link existing profiles to users based on current email matches\n-- This handles any existing data that needs to be linked\nupdate public.profiles p\nset user_id = u.id\nfrom public.users u\ninner join auth.users au on u.auth_user_id = au.id\nwhere p.work_email = lower(trim(au.email))\n  and (p.user_id is null or p.user_id = u.id);\n\ncomment on table public.profiles is 'User profile data with role and team membership.         "contents": "export function VerifyEmailForm() {\nconst handleSendOTP = async \n\n    }\n  };\n\n  /**\n   * Verifies the OTP code and links email identity to user\n   * Uses type 'email_change' since we're updating the user's email via updateUser()\n   * With enable_manual_linking = true, this will link the email identity\n   * to the existing authenticated user account\n   */\n  const verifyOTP = useCallback(async () =&gt; {\n    const trimmedOtp = otpCode.trim();\n\n    // Track the OTP being submitted to prevent re-submission\n    setLastSubmittedOtp(trimmedOtp);\n    setError(null);\n    setIsLoading(true);\n\n    try {\n      // Verify OTP code for email change/linking\n      // Use type 'email_change' because we used updateUser() to initiate the flow\n      // With enable_manual_linking = true, this will link the email identity\n      // to the current authenticated user instead of creating a new user\n      const { error: verifyError } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n        email: email.trim(),\n        token: trimmedOtp,\n        type: \"email_change\",\n      });\n\n      if (verifyError) {\n        setError(verifyError.message || \"Invalid OTP code\");\n        setIsLoading(false);\n        // Keep lastSubmittedOtp set to prevent re-submission of the same code\n        // The code remains in the input so user can see what they entered\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Refresh session to ensure identities are updated\n      await supabase.auth.refreshSession();\n\n      // Clear persisted state on success\n      clearPersistedState();\n\n      // Success - redirect to protected page\n      router.push(\"/protected\");\n      router.refresh();\n    } catch (err) {\n      setError(\"An unexpected error occurred\");\n      setIsLoading(false);\n      // Keep lastSubmittedOtp set to prevent re-submission of the same code\n    }\n  }, [email, otpCode, supabase, router]);\n\n  /**\n   * Handles form submission for OTP verification\n   */\n  const handleVerifyOTP = async (e: React.FormEvent) =&gt; {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    await verifyOTP();\n  };\n\n  /**\n   * Loads persisted state from sessionStorage after component mounts (client-side only)\n   * This prevents hydration mismatches between server and client\n   */\n}",
        "signatures": {
          "ranges": [
            {
              "startPosition": {

        "contents": "create table public.profiles (\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\n  name text not null,\n  picture text,\n  user_id uuid unique references public.users(id) on delete set null,\n  work_email text unique not null,\n  role public.profile_role not null default 'student',\n  team_id uuid references public.teams(id) on delete set null,\n  phone_number text,\n  personal_email text,\n  date_of_birth date,\n  removed_access timestamptz,\n  removed_access_by uuid references public.profiles(id) on delete set null,\n  created_at timestamptz default now() not null,\n  updated_at timestamptz default now() not null,\n  constraint valid_czu_domain check (\n    work_email like '%@studenti.czu.cz' or work_email like '%@pef.czu.cz'\n  )\n);\n\ncomment on table public.profiles is 'User profile data with role and team membership.         "contents": "import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from \"next/server\";\nimport { type EmailOtpType } from \"@supabase/supabase-js\";\n\n/**\n * Handles email change confirmation callback using PKCE flow with token_hash\n * Verifies the OTP token and redirects appropriately\n * Ensures cookies are properly set before redirecting\n */\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n  const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);\n  const token_hash = searchParams.get(\"token_hash\");\n  const type = searchParams.get(\"type\") as EmailOtpType | null;\n\n  let supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n    request,\n  });\n\n  if (token_hash &amp;&amp; type) {\n    const supabase = createServerClient(\n      process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,\n      process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY!,\n      {\n        cookies: {\n          getAll() {\n            return request.cookies.getAll();\n          },\n          setAll(cookiesToSet) {\n            cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value }) =&gt;\n              request.cookies.set(name, value),\n            );\n            supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n              request,\n            });\n            cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =&gt;\n              supabaseResponse.cookies.set(name, value, options),\n            );\n          },\n        },\n      },\n    );\n\n    const { error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n      type,\n      token_hash,\n    });\n\n    if (!error)\n}",

        "contents": "export function VerifyEmailForm() {\nconst handleSendOTP = async  {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    setError(null);\n    setIsLoading(true);\n\n    try {\n      // Validate email format\n      if (!email || !email.includes(\"@\")) {\n        setError(\"Please enter a valid email address\");\n        setIsLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Validate CZU domain\n      if (!isValidWorkEmailDomain(email.trim())) {\n        setError(\"Email must end with @pef.czu.cz or @studenti.czu.cz\");\n        setIsLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Use updateUser to add email identity to existing authenticated user\n      // This sends a verification link to the email address\n      // With enable_manual_linking = true, this will link the email identity\n      // Note: This adds the email as a secondary identity, not changing the primary email\n      const { data: updateData, error: updateError } = await supabase.auth.updateUser(\n        {\n          email: email.trim(),\n        },\n      );\n\n      if (updateError) {\n        // If email already exists, that's actually fine - it means it might already be linked\n        // or we need to handle it differently\n        if (updateError.message?.includes(\"already registered\")) {\n          setError(\"This email is already registered. {\n    const trimmedOtp = otpCode.trim();\n\n    // Track the OTP being submitted to prevent re-submission\n    setLastSubmittedOtp(trimmedOtp);\n    setError(null);\n    setIsLoading(true);\n\n    try {\n      // Verify OTP code for email change/linking\n      // Use type 'email_change' because we used updateUser() to initiate the flow\n      // With enable_manual_linking = true, this will link the email identity\n      // to the current authenticated user instead of creating a new user\n      const { error: verifyError } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n        email: email.trim(),\n        token: trimmedOtp,\n        type: \"email_change\",\n      });\n\n      if (verifyError) {\n        setError(verifyError.message || \"Invalid OTP code\");\n        setIsLoading(false);\n        // Keep lastSubmittedOtp set to prevent re-submission of the same code\n        // The code remains in the input so user can see what they entered\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Refresh session to ensure identities are updated\n      await supabase.auth.refreshSession();\n\n      // Clear persisted state on success\n      clearPersistedState();\n\n      // Success - redirect to protected page\n      router.push(\"/protected\");\n      router.refresh();\n    } catch (err) {\n      setError(\"An unexpected error occurred\");\n      setIsLoading(false);\n      // Keep lastSubmittedOtp set to prevent re-submission of the same code\n    }\n  }, [email, otpCode, supabase, router]);\n\n  /**\n   * Handles form submission for OTP verification\n   */\n  const handleVerifyOTP = async (e: React.FormEvent) =&gt;         "contents": "   - No Row Level Security policies\n   - No database triggers or functions\n   - All access control handled by Next.js\n\n### Next.js (Application Layer - All Business Logic)\n\n1. **Middleware Verification**:\n\n   - Queries &#96;profiles&#96; table for linked user_id\n   - Checks &#96;removed_access&#96; is null for active access\n   - Enforces role-based route protection\n   - Real-time verification (instant access revocation)\n\n2. **Domain Validation** (in server actions):\n\n   - Client-side validation for UX (immediate feedback)\n   - Server-side validation before sending OTP\n   - Validates email format and CZU domain\n\n3. **Access Management** (in server actions):\n\n   - Admin sets &#96;removed_access&#96; timestamp and &#96;removed_access_by&#96; profile\n   - Immediate effect on next request\n   - Audit trail of who revoked access and when\n\n## Authentication Flow Details\n\n### Step 1: Google Login\n\nUser clicks Google login button, Supabase handles OAuth flow.\n\n### Step 2: Work Email Input with Domain Validation\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Validate domain before sending OTP\nif (!isValidWorkEmailDomain(workEmail)) {\n  throw new Error('Email must be @studenti.czu.cz or @pef.czu.cz');\n}\n\n// Send OTP to work email (only after domain validation passes)\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOtp({\n  email: workEmail,\n  options: { shouldCreateUser: false }\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 3: OTP Verification and Profile Linking\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// After user enters OTP, verify it\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n  email: workEmail,\n  token: otpCode,\n  type: 'email'\n});\n\n// Check if profile exists for this work email\nconst { data: profile } = await supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .select('id')\n  .eq('work_email', workEmail)\n  .single();\n\nif (!profile) {\n  // No profile exists - redirect to pending approval\n  redirect('/auth/pending-approval');\n}\n\n// Link profile to current user\nconst { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\nawait supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .update({ \n    user_id: user.id,",

        "contents": "/**\n * Form component for email verification via OTP\n * Allows users to link an email identity to their Google OAuth account\n */\nexport function VerifyEmailForm() {\n  const [email, setEmail] = useState(\"\");\n  const [otpCode, setOtpCode] = useState(\"\");\n  const [step, setStep] = useState&lt;\"email\" | \"otp\"&gt;(\"email\");\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);\n  const [error, setError] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);\n  const [isHydrated, setIsHydrated] = useState(false);\n  const [lastSubmittedOtp, setLastSubmittedOtp] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);\n  const router = useRouter();\n  const supabase = createClient();\n\n  /**\n   * Sends OTP code to the provided email\n   * Uses updateUser to add email identity to the current authenticated user\n   * This is the correct way to link an email identity to an existing OAuth account\n   */\n  const handleSendOTP = async (e: React.FormEvent) =&gt; {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    setError(null);\n    setIsLoading(true);\n;\n}",

        "contents": "## Architecture Overview\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;mermaid\nflowchart TD\n    subgraph auth_flow [Authentication Flow]\n        A[User clicks Google Login] --&gt; B[Google OAuth]\n        B --&gt; C[Redirect back with Google identity]\n        C --&gt; D{Profile linked to user?}\n        D --&gt;|No| E[Prompt for work email]\n        E --&gt; F{Domain is czu.cz?}\n        F --&gt;|No| G[Show domain error]\n        G --&gt; E\n        F --&gt;|Yes| H[Send OTP to work email]\n        H --&gt; I[User enters OTP]\n        I --&gt; J{Profile exists for work email?}\n        J --&gt;|No| K[Pending Approval Page]\n        J --&gt;|Yes| L[Link profile to user]\n        D --&gt;|Yes| M{Access revoked?}\n        L --&gt; M\n        M --&gt;|Yes| N[Show access revoked]\n        M --&gt;|No| O[Grant Full Access]\n    end\n\n    subgraph request_flow [Request Validation]\n        P[Incoming Request] --&gt; Q[Middleware queries database]\n        Q --&gt; R{Profile linked to user?}\n        R --&gt;|No| S[Redirect to verify email]\n        R --&gt;|Yes| T{removed_access is null?}\n        T --&gt;|No| U[Show access revoked]\n        T --&gt;|Yes| V[Allow access]\n    end\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Validation Flow\n\n**Two-stage validation:**\n\n1. **Before OTP (Domain Check)**: Validate email ends with &#96;@studenti.czu.cz&#96; or &#96;@pef.czu.cz&#96;\n\n   - Client-side: Immediate feedback\n   - Server-side: Validated before &#96;signInWithOtp&#96; is called\n\n2. **After OTP (Profile Linking)**: Check if a profile exists for the verified work email\n\n   - If profile exists with that work_email → link profile to auth.user\n   - If no profile exists → show \"Pending Approval\" (admin must create profile first)\n   - Checked on every request via middleware\n\n## Database Schema (Supabase Migrations)\n\nTwo tables with **no RLS** - all access control is handled in Next.js:\n\n1. **&#96;users&#96;** - Custom table to sync with auth.users (Google OAuth), synced via Next.js server actions\n2. **&#96;profiles&#96;** - User authentication profile data with role and access control\n\n**Important**: No Supabase functions, triggers, or RLS policies. All business logic lives in Next.js.\n\nUse MODDATETIME extension to set the &#96;updated_at&#96; column on every update.",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "## Architecture Overview",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;mermaid",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "flowchart TD",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "    subgraph auth_flow [Authentication Flow]",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "        A[User clicks Google Login] --&gt; B[Google OAuth]",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "        B --&gt; C[Redirect back with Google identity]",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "        C --&gt; D{Profile linked to user?}",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "        D --&gt;|No| E[Prompt for work email]",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "        E --&gt; F{Domain is czu.cz?}",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "        F --&gt;|No| G[Show domain error]",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "        G --&gt; E",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "        F --&gt;|Yes| H[Send OTP to work email]",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "        H --&gt; I[User enters OTP]",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "        I --&gt; J{Profile exists for work email?}",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "        J --&gt;|No| K[Pending Approval Page]",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "        J --&gt;|Yes| L[Link profile to user]",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "        D --&gt;|Yes| M{Access revoked?}",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "        L --&gt; M",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "        M --&gt;|Yes| N[Show access revoked]",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "        M --&gt;|No| O[Grant Full Access]",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "    end",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "    subgraph request_flow [Request Validation]",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "        P[Incoming Request] --&gt; Q[Middleware queries database]",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "        Q --&gt; R{Profile linked to user?}",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "text": "        R --&gt;|No| S[Redirect to verify email]",
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "        R --&gt;|Yes| T{removed_access is null?}",
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "text": "        T --&gt;|No| U[Show access revoked]",

          },
          {

          },

          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 71
          },
          {
            "text": "## Validation Flow",
            "lineNumber": 72
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 73
          },
          {
            "text": "**Two-stage validation:**",
            "lineNumber": 74
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 75
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **Before OTP (Domain Check)**: Validate email ends with &#96;@studenti.czu.cz&#96; or &#96;@pef.czu.cz&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 76
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 77
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Client-side: Immediate feedback",
            "lineNumber": 78
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Server-side: Validated before &#96;signInWithOtp&#96; is called",
            "lineNumber": 79
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 80
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **After OTP (Profile Linking)**: Check if a profile exists for the verified work email",
            "lineNumber": 81
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 82
          },
          {
            "text": "   - If profile exists with that work_email → link profile to auth.user",
            "lineNumber": 83
          },
          {
            "text": "   - If no profile exists → show \"Pending Approval\" (admin must create profile first)",
            "lineNumber": 84
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Checked on every request via middleware",
            "lineNumber": 85
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 86
          },
          {
            "text": "## Database Schema (Supabase Migrations)",
            "lineNumber": 87
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 88
          },
          {
            "text": "Two tables with **no RLS** - all access control is handled in Next.js:",
            "lineNumber": 89
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 90
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **&#96;users&#96;** - Custom table to sync with auth.users (Google OAuth), synced via Next.js server actions",
            "lineNumber": 91
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **&#96;profiles&#96;** - User authentication profile data with role and access control",
            "lineNumber": 92
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 93
          },
          {
            "text": "**Important**: No Supabase functions, triggers, or RLS policies. All business logic lives in Next.js.",
            "lineNumber": 94
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 95
          },
          {
            "text": "Use MODDATETIME extension to set the &#96;updated_at&#96; column on every update.",
            "lineNumber": 96
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.40755391120910645

        "contents": "export function VerifyEmailForm() {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Loads persisted state from sessionStorage after component mounts (client-side only)\n   * This prevents hydration mismatches between server and client\n   */\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    const persisted = loadPersistedState();\n\n    // Validate persisted state - if on OTP step but no email, reset to email step\n    if (persisted.step === \"otp\" &amp;&amp; (!persisted.email || !persisted.email.includes(\"@\"))) {\n      setStep(\"email\");\n      setEmail(\"\");\n      clearPersistedState();\n      setIsHydrated(true);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // Restore persisted state if valid\n    if (persisted.email &amp;&amp; persisted.email.includes(\"@\")) {\n      setEmail(persisted.email);\n    }\n    if (persisted.step === \"email\" || persisted.step === \"otp\") {\n      setStep(persisted.step);\n    }\n\n    setIsHydrated(true);\n  }, []);\n\n  /**\n   * Persists email changes to sessionStorage\n   * Only saves when we have a valid email address and after hydration\n   */\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    // Don't persist until after hydration to avoid hydration mismatches\n    if (!isHydrated) return;\n\n    if (email &amp;&amp; email.includes(\"@\")) {\n      savePersistedState({ step, email });\n    } else if (step === \"otp\" &amp;&amp; !email) {\n      // If on OTP step but no email, clear invalid state\n      clearPersistedState();\n    }\n  }, [email, step, isHydrated]);\n\n  /**\n   * Auto-submits the form when OTP code reaches the expected length\n   * This handles paste events and manual entry\n   * Prevents re-submission of the same OTP code after a failed verification\n   */\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    const trimmedOtp = otpCode.trim();\n    const isOtpComplete = trimmedOtp.length === OTP_LENGTH;\n    const isNewOtp = trimmedOtp !== lastSubmittedOtp;\n\n    if (step === \"otp\" &amp;&amp; isOtpComplete &amp;&amp; !isLoading &amp;&amp; isNewOtp) {\n      verifyOTP();\n    }\n  }, [otpCode, step, isLoading, lastSubmittedOtp, verifyOTP]);\n\n  return (\n    &lt;Card&gt;\n      &lt;CardHeader&gt;\n}",

        "contents": "import { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport { type NextRequest } from \"next/server\";\n\nimport { hasEmailIdentity } from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\nimport { validateRedirectUrl } from \"@/lib/utils\";\n\n/**\n * Handles OAuth callback from Google\n * Exchanges the code for a session and redirects appropriately\n */\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n  const { searchParams, origin } = new URL(request.url);\n  const code = searchParams.get(\"code\");\n  const next = searchParams.get(\"next\");\n\n  if (code) {\n    const supabase = await createClient();\n    const { error } = await supabase.auth.exchangeCodeForSession(code);\n\n    if (!error) {\n      // Check if user has email identity linked\n      // If not, redirect to verify-email page\n      const hasEmail = await hasEmailIdentity();\n\n      // Validate the next parameter to prevent open redirects\n      const validatedNext = validateRedirectUrl(next, origin);\n      const redirectTo = validatedNext || (hasEmail ? \"/protected\" : \"/auth/verify-email\");\n\n      redirect(redirectTo);\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Redirect to error page if something went wrong\n  redirect(&#96;/auth/error?error=Failed to authenticate with Google&#96;);\n}",

        "contents": "import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from \"next/server\";\nimport { type EmailOtpType } from \"@supabase/supabase-js\";\n\n/**\n * Handles email change confirmation callback using PKCE flow with token_hash\n * Verifies the OTP token and redirects appropriately\n * Ensures cookies are properly set before redirecting\n */\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n  const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);\n  const token_hash = searchParams.get(\"token_hash\");\n  const type = searchParams.get(\"type\") as EmailOtpType | null;\n\n  let supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n    request,\n  });\n\n  if (token_hash &amp;&amp; type) {\n    const supabase = createServerClient(\n      process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,\n      process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY!,\n      {\n        cookies: {\n          getAll() {\n            return request.cookies.getAll();\n          },\n          setAll(cookiesToSet) {\n            cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value }) =&gt;\n              request.cookies.set(name, value),\n            );\n            supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n              request,\n            });\n            cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =&gt;\n              supabaseResponse.cookies.set(name, value, options),\n            );\n          },\n        },\n      },\n    );\n\n    const { error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n      type,\n      token_hash,\n    });\n\n    if (!error)\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * Checks if the authenticated user has an email identity linked\n * (not just OAuth providers like Google)\n * @returns true if user has an email identity, false otherwise\n */\nexport async function hasEmailIdentity(): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  const { data: { user }, error } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n  if (error || !user) {\n    return false;\n  }\n\n  // Check if user has an email identity (not just OAuth)\n  // User identities include: email, google, etc.\n  // We need at least one email identity\n  const identities = user.identities || [];\n\n  // Check if any identity is an email identity (not OAuth)\n  return identities.some(\n    (identity) =&gt; identity.provider === \"email\"\n  );\n}\n\n/**\n * Checks if the authenticated user has a linked profile\n * @returns true if user has a linked profile, false otherwise\n */",

        "contents": "import { EnvVarWarning } from \"@/components/env-var-warning\";\nimport { AuthButton } from \"@/components/auth-button\";\nimport { ThemeSwitcher } from \"@/components/theme-switcher\";\nimport Link from \"next/link\";\nimport { Suspense } from \"react\";\nimport { createClient } from \"@/lib/supabase/server\";\nimport { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport { hasEmailIdentity } from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\n\nexport default async function ProtectedLayout({\n  children,\n}: {\n  children: React.ReactNode;\n}) {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\n\n  // Redirect to login if not authenticated\n  if (!data?.claims) {\n    redirect(\"/auth/login\");\n  }\n\n  // Redirect to verify email if no email identity linked\n  const hasEmail = await hasEmailIdentity();\n  if (!hasEmail) {\n    redirect(\"/auth/verify-email\");\n  }\n\n  return (\n    &lt;main className=\"min-h-screen flex flex-col items-center\"&gt;\n}",

        "contents": "## Supabase Configuration Changes\n\nUpdate [&#96;supabase/config.toml&#96;](supabase/config.toml):\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n[auth]\nenable_manual_linking = true        # Required for work email linking\nenable_anonymous_sign_ins = false   # Block anonymous access\n\n[auth.email]\nenable_signup = false               # Block direct email/password signup\nenable_confirmations = false        # We use OTP for work email, not signup confirmation\n\n[auth.external.google]\nenabled = true\nclient_id = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID)\"\nsecret = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET)\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Profile Verification (Next.js Middleware)\n\nAll verification logic lives in Next.js middleware, not in Supabase:\n\n- **Profile Linked**: Check &#96;profiles.user_id&#96; matches current auth.user.id\n- **Access Active**: Check &#96;profiles.removed_access IS NULL&#96;\n- **User Role**: Read &#96;profiles.role&#96; column (student, team_leader, coach, admin)\n\nThis approach:\n\n- Keeps all business logic in Next.js (single source of truth)\n- Allows real-time updates (e.g., instant access revocation)\n- Admin pre-creates profiles, users link via work email verification\n- Supabase only handles auth + data storage (no custom hooks or functions)\n\n## Development &amp; Testing with Supabase MCP\n\nThe project has a &#96;supabase/&#96; directory with Supabase MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration available for:\n\n1. **Running migrations**: Apply and test database schema changes locally\n2. **Debugging auth flow**: Inspect user sessions and profile data\n3. **Testing verification logic**: Query profiles table for auth checks\n\n**Useful MCP commands for development:**\n\n- Seed test data into profiles table for auth testing\n- Inspect auth.users and profiles tables\n- Test profile linking and access revocation queries\n\n## Key Security Features\n\n### Supabase (Data Layer Only)\n\n1. **Database Constraints**:\n\n   - Domain constraint ensures only valid CZU domains in profiles\n   - Unique constraints on work_email, user_id\n\n2. **No RLS or Functions**:\n\n   - No Row Level Security policies\n   - No database triggers or functions",

        "contents": "-- Migration: Link users to profiles based on email matching\n-- Purpose: Automatically links profile rows to user rows when auth.users.email matches profiles.work_email\n-- Affected tables: profiles, users, auth.users\n-- Special considerations: Runs automatically when user email changes in auth.users table\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- FUNCTIONS\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Create trigger function to link profiles to users based on email matching\n-- Matches auth.users.email with profiles.work_email and links via public.users\n-- Runs with SECURITY DEFINER to access auth.users table\ncreate or replace function public.link_user_to_profile()\nreturns trigger\nlanguage plpgsql\nsecurity definer\nset search_path = public, auth\nas $$\ndeclare\n  v_user_id uuid;\n  v_auth_email text;\nbegin\n  -- Get the email from auth.users (use NEW.email after update)\n  v_auth_email := new.email;\n  \n  -- Only proceed if email is not null and has changed\n  if v_auth_email is null or v_auth_email = '' then\n    return new;\n  end if;\n  \n  -- Find the public.users row that matches this auth.users.id\n  select id into v_user_id\n  from public.users\n  where auth_user_id = new.id;\n  \n  -- If no matching public.users row found, return early\n  if v_user_id is null then\n    return new;\n  end if;\n  \n  -- Link profile to user if work_email matches auth.users.email\n  -- Only update if profile exists and is not already linked to a different user\n  update public.profiles\n  set user_id = v_user_id\n  where work_email = lower(trim(v_auth_email))\n    and (user_id is null or user_id = v_user_id);\n  \n  return new;\nend;\n$$;\n\ncomment on function public.link_user_to_profile() is 'Trigger function that automatically links profile rows to user rows when auth.users.email matches profiles.work_email. Matches based on currently logged in user email (auth.users.email), uid in user table row (public.users.auth_user_id), and work_email in profile table row (public.profiles.work_email).';\n\n-- ============================================================================",

        "contents": "│ email (google)  │   │   │ name            │\n│ ...auth fields  │   └───│ user_id (1:1)   │\n└─────────────────┘       │ work_email      │\n                          │ role (enum)     │\n                          │ removed_access  │\n                          │ removed_access_by│──┐\n                          │ created_at      │  │\n                          │ updated_at      │  │\n                          └─────────────────┘  │\n                                    ▲          │\n                                    └──────────┘ (self-reference)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Verification Logic\n\n- **Unverified**: &#96;profiles.user_id IS NULL&#96; → User logged in with Google but hasn't verified work email\n- **Pending Approval**: Work email verified via OTP, but no profile exists with that email\n- **Verified &amp; Active**: &#96;profiles.user_id IS NOT NULL AND profiles.removed_access IS NULL&#96;\n- **Access Revoked**: &#96;profiles.removed_access IS NOT NULL&#96;\n\n## Constants\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// lib/constants/auth.ts\nexport const ALLOWED_WORK_EMAIL_DOMAINS = [\n  'studenti.czu.cz',\n  'pef.czu.cz',\n] as const;\n\nexport const isValidWorkEmailDomain = (email: string): boolean =&gt; {\n  const domain = email.split('@')[1]?.toLowerCase();\n  return ALLOWED_WORK_EMAIL_DOMAINS.includes(domain as any);\n};\n\n// Profile roles (matches database enum)\nexport const PROFILE_ROLES = ['student', 'team_leader', 'coach', 'admin'] as const;\nexport type ProfileRole = typeof PROFILE_ROLES[number];\n\n// Role hierarchy for permission checks\nexport const ROLE_HIERARCHY: Record&lt;ProfileRole, number&gt; = {\n  student: 0,\n  team_leader: 1,\n  coach: 2,\n  admin: 3,\n} as const;\n\nexport const hasMinimumRole = (userRole: ProfileRole, requiredRole: ProfileRole): boolean =&gt; {\n  return ROLE_HIERARCHY[userRole] &gt;= ROLE_HIERARCHY[requiredRole];\n};\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Supabase Configuration Changes\n\nUpdate [&#96;supabase/config.toml&#96;](supabase/config.toml):\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n[auth]\nenable_manual_linking = true        # Required for work email linking",

        "contents": "comment on function public.link_user_to_profile() is 'Trigger function that automatically links profile rows to user rows when auth.users.email matches profiles.work_email. Matches based on currently logged in user email (auth.users.email), uid in user table row (public.users.auth_user_id), and work_email in profile table row (public.profiles.work_email).';\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- TRIGGERS\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Create trigger on auth.users table to link profiles when email changes\n-- Runs AFTER UPDATE to ensure email change is committed\ndrop trigger if exists link_user_to_profile_trigger on auth.users;\n\ncreate trigger link_user_to_profile_trigger\nafter update of email on auth.users\nfor each row\nwhen (old.email is distinct from new.email)\nexecute function public.link_user_to_profile();\n\ncomment on trigger link_user_to_profile_trigger on auth.users is 'Trigger that automatically links profiles to users when auth.users.email changes. Runs after email update to ensure the change is committed before linking.';\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- INITIAL DATA LINKING\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Link existing profiles to users based on current email matches\n-- This handles any existing data that needs to be linked\nupdate public.profiles p\nset user_id = u.id\nfrom public.users u\ninner join auth.users au on u.auth_user_id = au.id\nwhere p.work_email = lower(trim(au.email))\n  and (p.user_id is null or p.user_id = u.id);\n\ncomment on table public.profiles is 'User profile data with role and team membership. Pre-created by admin, linked to user after OTP verification. Automatically linked when auth.users.email matches profiles.work_email.';\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- GRANTS\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Grant execute permissions for the trigger function",

        "contents": "await supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .update({ \n    user_id: user.id,\n    picture: user.user_metadata.avatar_url  // Default to Google picture\n  })\n  .eq('work_email', workEmail);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 4: Middleware Validation\n\nQuery database for profile linked to current auth.user and check &#96;removed_access IS NULL&#96; on every request to protected routes.\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Middleware check\nconst { data: profile } = await supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .select('id, role, removed_access')\n  .eq('user_id', user.id)\n  .single();\n\nif (!profile) redirect('/auth/verify-work-email');\nif (profile.removed_access) redirect('/auth/access-revoked');\n// User has active access, continue...\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Estimated Complexity\n\n| Task | Complexity | Lines of Code |\n\n|------|------------|---------------|\n\n| Delete old auth files | Trivial | -500 lines |\n\n| Security lockdown config | Trivial | ~20 lines TOML |\n\n| Database migration | Low | ~40 lines SQL (users, profiles, indexes) |\n\n| Constants + validation | Trivial | ~25 lines |\n\n| Server actions (auth logic) | Medium | ~60 lines |\n\n| Middleware update | Medium | ~50 lines (includes DB queries) |\n\n| Google login page | Low | ~30 lines |\n\n| Work email form + linking | Medium | ~120 lines |\n\n| Pending approval page | Low | ~20 lines |\n\n| Access revoked page | Low | ~20 lines |\n\n**Total new code**: ~385 lines (vs ~500 lines deleted)\n\n## Separation of Concerns\n\n### Supabase (Auth + Storage Only)\n\n- **Authentication**: Google OAuth flow, session management, OTP emails\n- **Database**: Store profiles and users data (no RLS - Next.js handles access control)\n- **No business logic**: No custom hooks, no stored procedures, no triggers, no functions\n\n### Next.js (All Business Logic)\n\n- **Middleware**: Profile verification, access checks, role-based routing\n- **Server Actions**: Profile linking, access revocation\n- **Validation**: Domain validation, input sanitization, business rules\n- **Authorization**: Role hierarchy checks, permission enforcement\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│                         Next.js                                  │",

        "contents": "export function VerifyEmailForm() {\n (\n          &lt;form onSubmit={handleVerifyOTP} className=\"flex flex-col gap-4\"&gt;\n            &lt;div className=\"flex flex-col gap-2\"&gt;\n              &lt;Label htmlFor=\"otp\"&gt;OTP Code&lt;/Label&gt;\n              &lt;Input\n                id=\"otp\"\n                type=\"text\"\n                placeholder={&#96;Enter ${OTP_LENGTH}-digit code&#96;}\n                value={otpCode}\n                onChange={(e) =&gt; {\n                  const newValue = e.target.value.replace(/\\D/g, \"\").slice(0, OTP_LENGTH);\n                  setOtpCode(newValue);\n                  // Clear lastSubmittedOtp when user starts typing a new code\n                  if (lastSubmittedOtp !== null &amp;&amp; newValue !== lastSubmittedOtp) {\n                    setLastSubmittedOtp(null);\n                  }\n                }}\n                onPaste={(e) =&gt; {\n                  e.preventDefault();\n                  const pastedText = e.clipboardData.getData(\"text\").replace(/\\D/g, \"\").slice(0, OTP_LENGTH);\n                  setOtpCode(pastedText);\n                  // Clear lastSubmittedOtp when user pastes a new code\n                  if (lastSubmittedOtp !== null &amp;&amp; pastedText !== lastSubmittedOtp) {\n                    setLastSubmittedOtp(null);\n                  }\n                }}\n                disabled={isLoading}\n                required\n                autoFocus\n                maxLength={OTP_LENGTH}\n              /&gt;\n              &lt;p className=\"text-xs text-muted-foreground\"&gt;\n                Check your email for the verification code\n              &lt;/p&gt;\n            &lt;/div&gt;\n            &lt;div className=\"flex flex-col gap-2\"&gt;\n              &lt;Button type=\"submit\" disabled={isLoading} className=\"w-full\"&gt;\n}",

Provided domain: %', v_domain;\n      end if;\n    end if;\n  end if;\n\n  if OLD.email is distinct from NEW.email then\n    v_email := NEW.email;\n    \n    if v_email is not null and v_email != '' then\n      v_domain := lower(split_part(v_email, '@', 2));\n      \n      if v_domain not in ('pef.czu.cz', 'studenti.czu.cz') then\n        raise exception 'Email must end with @pef.czu.cz or @studenti.czu.cz.         "contents": "create table public.profiles (\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\n  name text not null,\n  picture text,\n  user_id uuid unique references public.users(id) on delete set null,\n  work_email text unique not null,\n  role public.profile_role not null default 'student',\n  team_id uuid references public.teams(id) on delete set null,\n  phone_number text,\n  personal_email text,\n  date_of_birth date,\n  removed_access timestamptz,\n  removed_access_by uuid references public.profiles(id) on delete set null,\n  created_at timestamptz default now() not null,\n  updated_at timestamptz default now() not null,\n  constraint valid_czu_domain check (\n    work_email like '%@studenti.czu.cz' or work_email like '%@pef.czu.cz'\n  )\n);\n\ncomment on table public.profiles is 'User profile data with role and team membership. Pre-created by admin, linked to user after OTP verification.';\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- FUNCTIONS\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Create trigger function to automatically update updated_at column\ncreate or replace function public.handle_updated_at()\nreturns trigger\nlanguage plpgsql\nsecurity invoker\nset search_path = ''\nas $$\nbegin\n  new.updated_at := now();\n  return new;\nend;\n$$;\n\ncomment on function public.handle_updated_at() is 'Trigger function that automatically updates the updated_at column to the current timestamp on row updates.';\n\n-- Create trigger function to populate public.users on auth.users creation\n-- Extracts Google OAuth data from auth.users.raw_user_meta_data and auth.users.email\ncreate or replace function public.handle_new_auth_user()\nreturns trigger\nlanguage plpgsql\nsecurity definer\nset search_path = public, auth\nas $$\ndeclare\n  v_google_email text;\n  v_google_full_name text;\n  v_google_profile_picture text;\n  v_raw_meta_data jsonb;\nbegin\n  v_raw_meta_data := new.raw_user_meta_data;",

        "contents": "import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from \"next/server\";\n\nexport async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {\n  let supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n    request,\n  });\n\n  // If the env vars are not set, skip proxy check. You can remove this\n  // once you setup the project.\n\n  // With Fluid compute, don't put this client in a global environment\n  // variable. Always create a new one on each request.\n  const supabase = createServerClient(\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY!,\n    {\n      cookies: {\n        getAll() {\n          return request.cookies.getAll();\n        },\n        setAll(cookiesToSet) {\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value }) =&gt;\n            request.cookies.set(name, value),\n          );\n          supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n            request,\n          });\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =&gt;\n            supabaseResponse.cookies.set(name, value, options),\n          );\n        },\n      },\n    },\n  );\n\n  // Do not run code between createServerClient and\n  // supabase.auth.getClaims().         "contents": "import { EnvVarWarning } from \"@/components/env-var-warning\";\nimport { AuthButton } from \"@/components/auth-button\";\nimport { ThemeSwitcher } from \"@/components/theme-switcher\";\nimport Link from \"next/link\";\nimport { Suspense } from \"react\";\nimport { createClient } from \"@/lib/supabase/server\";\nimport { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport { hasEmailIdentity } from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\n\nexport default async function ProtectedLayout({\n  children,\n}: {\n  children: React.ReactNode;\n}) {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\n\n  // Redirect to login if not authenticated\n  if (!data?.claims) {\n    redirect(\"/auth/login\");\n  }\n\n  // Redirect to verify email if no email identity linked\n  const hasEmail = await hasEmailIdentity();\n  if (!hasEmail) {\n    redirect(\"/auth/verify-email\");\n  }\n\n  return (\n    &lt;main className=\"min-h-screen flex flex-col items-center\"&gt;\n}",

        "contents": "export async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {\n\n\n  // Check for linked profile if user is authenticated and not on public routes\n  if (user &amp;&amp; !isPublicRoute) {\n    // Get the public.users row linked to this auth user\n    const { data: publicUser } = await supabase\n      .from(\"users\")\n      .select(\"id\")\n      .eq(\"auth_user_id\", user.sub)\n      .single();\n\n    // If no publicUser or no linked profile, redirect to pending approval\n    if (!publicUser) {\n      const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n      url.pathname = \"/auth/pending-approval\";\n      return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n    }\n\n    // Check if there's a profile linked to this user\n    const { data: profile } = await supabase\n      .from(\"profiles\")\n      .select(\"id\")\n      .eq(\"user_id\", publicUser.id)\n      .single();\n\n    if (!profile) {\n      // User doesn't have a linked profile, redirect to pending approval\n      const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n      url.pathname = \"/auth/pending-approval\";\n      return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n    }\n  }\n\n  // IMPORTANT: You *must* return the supabaseResponse object as it is.\n  // If you're creating a new response object with NextResponse.next() make sure to:\n  // 1. Pass the request in it, like so:\n  //    const myNewResponse = NextResponse.next({ request })\n  // 2. Copy over the cookies, like so:\n  //    myNewResponse.cookies.setAll(supabaseResponse.cookies.getAll())\n  // 3. Change the myNewResponse object to fit your needs, but avoid changing\n  //    the cookies!\n  // 4. Finally:\n  //    return myNewResponse\n  // If this is not done, you may be causing the browser and server to go out\n  // of sync and terminate the user's session prematurely!\n\n  return supabaseResponse;\n}",

        "contents": "import { cookies } from \"next/headers\";\n\n/**\n * Especially important if using Fluid compute: Don't put this client in a\n * global variable. Always create a new client within each function when using\n * it.\n */\nexport async function createClient() {\n  const cookieStore = await cookies();\n\n  return createServerClient(\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY!,\n    {\n      cookies: {\n        getAll() {\n          return cookieStore.getAll();\n        },\n        setAll(cookiesToSet) {\n          try {\n            cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =&gt;\n              cookieStore.set(name, value, options),\n            );\n          } catch {\n            // The &#96;setAll&#96; method was called from a Server Component.\n            // This can be ignored if you have proxy refreshing\n            // user sessions.\n          }\n        },\n      },\n    },\n  );\n}",

        "contents": "import { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport { hasLinkedProfile } from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\n\n/**\n * Pending approval page\n * Shown to users who have verified their email but don't have a linked profile yet\n */\nexport default async function PendingApprovalPage() {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\n\n  // Redirect to login if not authenticated\n  if (!data?.claims) {\n    redirect(\"/auth/login\");\n  }\n\n  // Redirect to protected if already has linked profile\n  const hasProfile = await hasLinkedProfile();\n  if (hasProfile) {\n    redirect(\"/protected\");\n  }\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"flex min-h-svh w-full items-center justify-center p-6 md:p-10\"&gt;\n      &lt;div className=\"w-full max-w-md\"&gt;\n        &lt;div className=\"flex flex-col gap-6\"&gt;\n          &lt;div className=\"flex flex-col gap-2\"&gt;\n            &lt;h1 className=\"text-2xl font-bold\"&gt;Pending Approval&lt;/h1&gt;\n            &lt;p className=\"text-muted-foreground\"&gt;\n              Your email address has been verified, but you need an admin to approve your account before you can access protected areas.\n            &lt;/p&gt;\n          &lt;/div&gt;\n          &lt;div className=\"rounded-lg border p-4 bg-muted/50\"&gt;\n            &lt;p className=\"text-sm\"&gt;\n              Please contact an administrator to approve your email address. Once approved, you will be able to access all protected areas of the application.\n            &lt;/p&gt;\n          &lt;/div&gt;\n        &lt;/div&gt;\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n    &lt;/div&gt;\n  );\n}",

        "contents": "await supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .update({ \n    user_id: user.id,\n    picture: user.user_metadata.avatar_url  // Default to Google picture\n  })\n  .eq('work_email', workEmail);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 4: Middleware Validation\n\nQuery database for profile linked to current auth.user and check &#96;removed_access IS NULL&#96; on every request to protected routes.\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Middleware check\nconst { data: profile } = await supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .select('id, role, removed_access')\n  .eq('user_id', user.id)\n  .single();\n\nif (!profile) redirect('/auth/verify-work-email');\nif (profile.removed_access) redirect('/auth/access-revoked');\n// User has active access, continue...\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Estimated Complexity\n\n| Task | Complexity | Lines of Code |\n\n|------|------------|---------------|\n\n| Delete old auth files | Trivial | -500 lines |\n\n| Security lockdown config | Trivial | ~20 lines TOML |\n\n| Database migration | Low | ~40 lines SQL (users, profiles, indexes) |\n\n| Constants + validation | Trivial | ~25 lines |\n\n| Server actions (auth logic) | Medium | ~60 lines |\n\n| Middleware update | Medium | ~50 lines (includes DB queries) |\n\n| Google login page | Low | ~30 lines |\n\n| Work email form + linking | Medium | ~120 lines |\n\n| Pending approval page | Low | ~20 lines |\n\n| Access revoked page | Low | ~20 lines |\n\n**Total new code**: ~385 lines (vs ~500 lines deleted)\n\n## Separation of Concerns\n\n### Supabase (Auth + Storage Only)\n\n- **Authentication**: Google OAuth flow, session management, OTP emails\n- **Database**: Store profiles and users data (no RLS - Next.js handles access control)\n- **No business logic**: No custom hooks, no stored procedures, no triggers, no functions\n\n### Next.js (All Business Logic)\n\n- **Middleware**: Profile verification, access checks, role-based routing\n- **Server Actions**: Profile linking, access revocation\n- **Validation**: Domain validation, input sanitization, business rules\n- **Authorization**: Role hierarchy checks, permission enforcement\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│                         Next.js                                  │",

        "contents": "## Supabase Configuration Changes\n\nUpdate [&#96;supabase/config.toml&#96;](supabase/config.toml):\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n[auth]\nenable_manual_linking = true        # Required for work email linking\nenable_anonymous_sign_ins = false   # Block anonymous access\n\n[auth.email]\nenable_signup = false               # Block direct email/password signup\nenable_confirmations = false        # We use OTP for work email, not signup confirmation\n\n[auth.external.google]\nenabled = true\nclient_id = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID)\"\nsecret = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET)\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Profile Verification (Next.js Middleware)\n\nAll verification logic lives in Next.js middleware, not in Supabase:\n\n- **Profile Linked**: Check &#96;profiles.user_id&#96; matches current auth.user.id\n- **Access Active**: Check &#96;profiles.removed_access IS NULL&#96;\n- **User Role**: Read &#96;profiles.role&#96; column (student, team_leader, coach, admin)\n\nThis approach:\n\n- Keeps all business logic in Next.js (single source of truth)\n- Allows real-time updates (e.g., instant access revocation)\n- Admin pre-creates profiles, users link via work email verification\n- Supabase only handles auth + data storage (no custom hooks or functions)\n\n## Development &amp; Testing with Supabase MCP\n\nThe project has a &#96;supabase/&#96; directory with Supabase MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration available for:\n\n1. **Running migrations**: Apply and test database schema changes locally\n2. **Debugging auth flow**: Inspect user sessions and profile data\n3. **Testing verification logic**: Query profiles table for auth checks\n\n**Useful MCP commands for development:**\n\n- Seed test data into profiles table for auth testing\n- Inspect auth.users and profiles tables\n- Test profile linking and access revocation queries\n\n## Key Security Features\n\n### Supabase (Data Layer Only)\n\n1. **Database Constraints**:\n\n   - Domain constraint ensures only valid CZU domains in profiles\n   - Unique constraints on work_email, user_id\n\n2. **No RLS or Functions**:\n\n   - No Row Level Security policies\n   - No database triggers or functions",

        "contents": "import { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport { type NextRequest } from \"next/server\";\n\nimport { hasEmailIdentity } from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\nimport { validateRedirectUrl } from \"@/lib/utils\";\n\n/**\n * Handles OAuth callback from Google\n * Exchanges the code for a session and redirects appropriately\n */\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n  const { searchParams, origin } = new URL(request.url);\n  const code = searchParams.get(\"code\");\n  const next = searchParams.get(\"next\");\n\n  if (code) {\n    const supabase = await createClient();\n    const { error } = await supabase.auth.exchangeCodeForSession(code);\n\n    if (!error) {\n      // Check if user has email identity linked\n      // If not, redirect to verify-email page\n      const hasEmail = await hasEmailIdentity();\n\n      // Validate the next parameter to prevent open redirects\n      const validatedNext = validateRedirectUrl(next, origin);\n      const redirectTo = validatedNext || (hasEmail ? \"/protected\" : \"/auth/verify-email\");\n\n      redirect(redirectTo);\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Redirect to error page if something went wrong\n  redirect(&#96;/auth/error?error=Failed to authenticate with Google&#96;);\n}",

        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./app/auth/verify-email/page.tsx",

        },
        "contents": "import { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport { VerifyEmailForm } from \"@/components/verify-email-form\";\nimport { hasEmailIdentity } from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\n\n/**\n * Email verification page\n * Users must link an email via OTP to their Google OAuth account\n */\nexport default async function VerifyEmailPage() {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\n\n  // Redirect to login if not authenticated\n  if (!data?.claims) {\n    redirect(\"/auth/login\");\n  }\n\n  // Redirect to protected if already has email identity\n  const hasEmail = await hasEmailIdentity();\n  if (hasEmail) {\n    redirect(\"/protected\");\n  }\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"flex min-h-svh w-full items-center justify-center p-6 md:p-10\"&gt;\n      &lt;div className=\"w-full max-w-sm\"&gt;\n        &lt;VerifyEmailForm /&gt;\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n    &lt;/div&gt;\n  );\n}",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "└─ e2e/                       # End-to-end tests\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Directory Conventions\n\n- Use **kebab-case** for folders and files\n- Co-locate tests next to source: &#96;*.test.ts(x)&#96;\n- Export from &#96;index.ts&#96; barrels only when it helps DX without circular deps\n\n## Next.js App Router Rules\n\n### Server vs Client Components\n\n- **Default to RSC** (no \"use client\"). Use client components only for:\n  - Interactivity (event handlers)\n  - Browser APIs (localStorage, window, etc.)\n  - Third-party libraries requiring client-side initialization\n\n### Server Boundaries\n\n- Keep data access in server context (RSC, server actions, API routes)\n- API routes in &#96;app/api&#96; are for external webhooks only\n- Use internal APIs (tRPC, server actions) for app-to-app communication\n\n### Performance &amp; UX\n\n- Use &#96;&lt;Suspense&gt;&#96; for async UI; provide skeletons\n- Implement proper loading and error boundaries\n- Use Next.js caching (&#96;revalidateTag&#96;, &#96;revalidatePath&#96;) appropriately\n- Prefer Edge runtime for simple operations, Node for complex ones\n\n### Accessibility\n\n- All interactive elements must have proper roles and labels\n- Ensure keyboard navigation support\n- Provide ARIA attributes where needed\n- Test with screen readers\n\n## API Architecture\n\n### Internal APIs (tRPC Recommended)\n\n- Organize by feature domains\n- Use Zod for input validation\n- Implement proper error handling with custom error classes\n- Keep business logic server-side (no JSX in API layer)\n- Write integration tests with mocked external services\n- **Router logic should be application code only** - delegate to business logic services\n- **Use only protected procedures** for all endpoints\n- **Split procedures and routers** into separate files for better organization\n\n### Application Logic vs Business Logic\n\n**Application Logic** (in tRPC procedures):\n- Input validation and sanitization\n- Authentication and authorization checks\n- Request/response formatting\n- Error handling and mapping\n- Delegation to business logic services\n- Logging and observability",
